verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel documents a dedicated small-business/start-ups practice and describes a J-1 Incubator Program it says it designed, in which university clients use on-campus incubators to sponsor founders. That counts as a glancing incubator-ecosystem arrangement. 'Cost-effective' is generic marketing language, not founder-community pricing. Missing for 10: named YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, founder or startup-community discounted pricing, independent corroboration.
